builds.name: Reference: Range and poke
builds.goal: Reference for Viktor: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A scaling control mage who earns ability augments, uses shielded Q attacks to trade and controls paths through laser, gravity field and a following storm. Fix ability augments, Q shield/empowered attack and storm contact. Spellblade needs a real Q attack; the defensive shield does not make all incoming damage irrelevant. Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment.
builds.summary: Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment.
testPlan: Kit question for Viktor: Fix ability augments, Q shield/empowered attack and storm contact. Spellblade needs a real Q attack; the defensive shield does not make all incoming damage irrelevant.

Start with the early core (Luden, then Horizon) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Viktor blasts an enemy unit with magic damage, which grants him a shield and empowers his next basic attack.

Augment: Siphon Power's shield is increased by 60% and Viktor gains bonus move speed after casting the Ability. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Comet can miss and distance matters; no automatic full-range damage bonus.

The route fails Viktor's stated kit question: Fix ability augments, Q shield/empowered attack and storm contact. Spellblade needs a real Q attack; the defensive shield does not make all incoming damage irrelevant.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Comet can miss and distance matters; no automatic full-range damage bonus.
Full cost 16,050 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Luden, then Horizon. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Banshee's Veil are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Viktor gains Hex Fragments whenever he kills an enemy. Every [100] Hex Fragments Viktor obtains will permanently upgrade an active Ability. After upgrading all of his basic Abilities, Viktor can upgrade his Ultimate Ability.

Killing minions grants [1] Hex Fragment.
Killing cannon minions grants [10] Hex Fragments.
Champion takedowns grant [20] Hex Fragments.

Viktor fires a hextech ray in a chosen direction, dealing [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage to any enemies it hits.

Upgraded: An aftershock follows Hextech Ray, dealing [20 / 50 / 80 / 110 / 140 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

Viktor deploys a gravitational imprisonment device for [4] seconds, Slowing enemies inside it by [(-33 / -36 / -39 / -42 / -45) × -1]%. Enemies who remain within its radius for 1.25 seconds are Stunned for [1.5] seconds.

Upgraded Passive: Viktor's Abilities Slow by [20]% for 1 second.

Viktor conjures an Arcane Storm in an area for [6.5] seconds, which instantly deals [100 / 175 / 250 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage followed by [65 / 105 / 145 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage per second to surrounding enemies. The storm automatically follows champions it has recently damaged.

Recast: Viktor can manually move the storm.

Upgraded: The storm moves [25]% faster. If a champion that the storm has damaged dies, the storm increases its size and its duration by [3] seconds (up to [6] times).

Viktor blasts an enemy, dealing [60 / 75 / 90 / 105 / 120 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage and granting Viktor [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 140; raw flags preserved) + (0.25) × AP] Shield for [2.5] seconds.

Viktor's next Attack within 4 seconds deals [20 / 45 / 70 / 95 / 120 + (0.5) × AP + (1) × AD] magic damage.

Upgraded: Grants [(characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 140; raw flags preserved) + (0.25) × AP) × (1.6)] Shield and Viktor additionally gains [30]% Move Speed for [2.5] seconds.

builds.name: Siphon movement attack
builds.summary: Explore repeated attack contact during the augmented Q shield and speed window.
builds.goal: Explore repeated attack contact during the augmented Q shield and speed window.
builds.hypothesis: Q grants an AP shield and a next attack dealing magic damage with 0.5 AP plus AD; augmentation multiplies shield by 1.6 and grants 30% move speed. Dusk and Dawn and Nashor supply item attack packets while Cosmic adds magic-contact movement. W provides a delayed stun only if the victim remains inside 1.25 seconds.
testPlan: Required state: Earn Q augment through finite fragments and complete the attack within four seconds.
Separate Q cast, empowered magic attack and item packets while measuring shield duration/attack uptime.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Extra attacks leave W zone or expose Viktor after the 2.5-second shield expires.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeated on-hits do not mean two Q empowerment consumptions.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Dusk and Dawn, Nashor's Tooth, Cosmic Drive, Riftmaker, Void Staff, Boots of Swiftness. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Growing storm cleanup
builds.summary: Test continued magic debuff contact as an upgraded storm grows after finite takedowns.
builds.goal: Test continued magic debuff contact as an upgraded storm grows after finite takedowns.
builds.hypothesis: R lasts 6.5 seconds, deals initial plus per-second AP magic damage, and its upgrade extends size/duration three seconds per damaged-champion death up to six times. Bloodletter and Liandry reward confirmed damage contact while Malignance tests ultimate-ground interaction. Cosmic supports manual storm shepherding and E aftershock if augmented.
testPlan: Required state: Record earned R upgrade, target path and actual takedowns/extension count.
Count R ticks and extension events at zero versus two takedowns, isolating Hatefog refresh.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Storm leaves targets or no deaths occur; the supposed cleanup ramp never starts.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: A six-extension cap does not grant all six extensions at fight start.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.

Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
